paper.title: Federated Contextual Cascading Bandits with Asynchronous Communication and Heterogeneous Users

settings.name_in_paper: Federated Contextual Combinatorial Cascading Bandits (FedC^3B) with heterogeneous users and asynchronous communication
unmapped: |U| agents each serving one user, asynchronous server-client communication; communication cost also measured
users partitioned into J unknown clusters with shared preference vectors theta^j, ||theta|| <= 1, minimum heterogeneity gap gamma between clusters (unknown)
users arrive uniformly at random from U each round
item features drawn i.i.d. from a distribution rho on the unit ball with E[xx^T] min eigenvalue lambda_x > 0 and sub-Gaussian (theta^T x)^2
click probability linear: E[w_t(i)] = <theta_{u_t}, x_{t,i}>; reward 1 - prod(1 - w) over list of length at most K
learner has an offline alpha-approximation oracle; regret is alpha-approximate
settings.definition_quote: In FedC$^3$B, there is a finite set $\mathcal{U}$ of users, to be served by $|\mathcal{U}|$ (local) learning agents individually. ... The goal of the agents is to collaboratively minimize the cumulative $\alpha$-approximate regret defined as Reg(T) = E[sum_t (alpha f(a*_t, w_t) - f(a_t, w_t))]

symbols.alpha_c: communication threshold of the determinant condition
symbols.gamma: minimum heterogeneity gap between cluster preference vectors
symbols.lambda_x_tilde: integral of (1-exp(-(lambda_x-x)^2/(2 sigma^2)))^I over [0, lambda_x]; lambda_x min eigenvalue of feature covariance

conditions: Assumptions 1-3: min heterogeneity gap gamma, uniform random user arrival, item regularity
tuning: alpha_c = 1/|U|^2 gives O~(d sqrt(J K T))

source.label: thm:main
source.quote: Under Assumptions 1-3 ..., if we set $\beta$ as in \cref{lem:concentration} ..., then the expected cumulative regret of \cref{alg:main} is upper bounded by Reg(T) \le O(d\sqrt{(J+|\cU|\alpha_c)(1+|\cU|^2\alpha_c)KT}\log T + |\cU|(d\gamma^{-2}\tilde{\lambda}_x^{-1}+\tilde{\lambda}^{-2}_x)\log T).

results.notes: Paper's K (max list length) mapped to m. Regret is alpha-approximate regret in expectation over user arrivals/contexts/clicks. beta depends on T so horizon treated as known.

source.label: thm:main
source.quote: The communication cost is bounded by $\text{Com}(T) \le O\left(d(\left | \mathcal{U} \right |+1/\alpha_c)\log T+ \log^2 T\right)$

results.notes: Communication cost = expected number of rounds with agent-server communication.
